No class is a statement about any medicine's safety.

metrics.compared: ATC codes: TİTCK and CIMA single-ingredient products against the key's Wikidata item and against each other. Substance codes: BDPM and CIMA. openFDA NDC publishes no ATC code and only product-level RxCUIs, so it adds presence counts only.

report.review_status: Generated by deterministic rules. Expert review has not yet been done: a pharmacist must check every finding before it is reported upstream.

rules.classes: confirmed_error: reviewed and listed in data/atc_code_exclusions.csv. needs_pharmacist: a difference no rule explains. benign_difference: a deterministic rule explains it. No class is a statement about any medicine's safety.
rules.exclusion_status: Each reviewed row of data/atc_code_exclusions.csv, class confirmed_error; upstream persisting when the source still publishes the code for the key, resolved_upstream when it no longer does (the row must then be removed).
rules.group: An ATC level-4 group is the first five characters of a code (for example R06AE).
rules.item_group: A code published by a regulator (TİTCK, AEMPS CIMA) on single-ingredient products of a key that shares no level-4 group with any code of the key's item (Wikidata or a curated Janus key). Benign difference only when both regulators publish the code for the key, no other key carries it and it is not a combination code; otherwise needs pharmacist.
rules.regulator_group: A key with single-ingredient products in both regulators whose codes share no level-4 group; always needs pharmacist.
rules.substance_code_keys: One substance code of BDPM or CIMA whose published names map to two or more keys; always needs pharmacist.
